question: For ports that are DOWN and appear in both the ML2 port bindings and security-group bindings views, list each port’s ID, name, tenant ID, MAC address, admin_state_up flag, binding host, and VIF type; also include (1) the average admin_state_up over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows within each VIF type ordered by MAC address, along with the DOWN-port count per VIF type and its deviation from the overall average across VIF types, and (2) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group plus the tenant’s total DOWN-port count, the average DOWN-port count across tenants as a benchmark, and the tenant category (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each tenant as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.admin_state_up,
         p.standard_attr_id, b.host, b.vif_type, s.security_group_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings s ON s.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
vif_counts AS (
  SELECT vif_type, COUNT(*) AS down_count_per_vif
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vif_type
),
vif_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(down_count_per_vif) AS overall_avg
  FROM vif_counts
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS tenant_down_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
tenant_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(tenant_down_count) AS avg_tenant_down
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT
  b.id, b.name, b.tenant_id, b.mac_address, b.admin_state_up,
  b.host, b.vif_type,
  AVG(b.admin_state_up) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY b.mac_address
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_admin_state_up_window,
  vc.down_count_per_vif,
  (vc.down_count_per_vif - a.overall_avg) AS deviation_from_overall_avg,
  SUM(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id
      ORDER BY b.mac_address ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_std_attr,
  tc.tenant_down_count,
  ta.avg_tenant_down AS avg_down_count_across_tenants,
  CASE
    WHEN tc.tenant_down_count >= ta.avg_tenant_down * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
    WHEN tc.tenant_down_count <= ta.avg_tenant_down * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
  END AS tenant_category
FROM base b
JOIN vif_counts vc ON vc.vif_type = b.vif_type
CROSS JOIN vif_avg a
JOIN tenant_counts tc ON tc.tenant_id = b.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN tenant_avg ta
ORDER BY b.vif_type, b.mac_address, b.security_group_id;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.admin_state_up,
         p.standard_attr_id, b.host, b.vif_type, s.security_group_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings s ON s.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
vif_counts AS (
  SELECT vif_type, COUNT(*) AS down_count_per_vif
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vif_type
),
vif_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(down_count_per_vif) AS overall_avg
  FROM vif_counts
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS tenant_down_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
tenant_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(tenant_down_count) AS avg_tenant_down
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT
  b.id, b.name, b.tenant_id, b.mac_address, b.admin_state_up,
  b.host, b.vif_type,
  AVG(b.admin_state_up) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY b.mac_address
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_admin_state_up_window,
  vc.down_count_per_vif,
  (vc.down_count_per_vif - a.overall_avg) AS deviation_from_overall_avg,
  SUM(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id
      ORDER BY b.mac_address ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_std_attr,
  tc.tenant_down_count,
  ta.avg_tenant_down AS avg_down_count_across_tenants,
  CASE
    WHEN tc.tenant_down_count >= ta.avg_tenant_down * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
    WHEN tc.tenant_down_count <= ta.avg_tenant_down * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
  END AS tenant_category
FROM base b
JOIN vif_counts vc ON vc.vif_type = b.vif_type
CROSS JOIN vif_avg a
JOIN tenant_counts tc ON tc.tenant_id = b.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN tenant_avg ta
ORDER BY b.vif_type, b.mac_address, b.security_group_id;

  FROM base

),

  SELECT AVG(down_count_per_vif) AS overall_avg
  FROM vif_counts

tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS tenant_down_count
  FROM base

  SELECT AVG(tenant_down_count) AS avg_tenant_down
  FROM tenant_counts

  b.id, b.name, b.tenant_id, b.mac_address, b.admin_state_up,

  AVG(b.admin_state_up) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY b.mac_address
